blocks.text: The Keysville Town Council will hold TWO PUBLIC HEARINGS on:
Date: Monday, October 20th Time: 7:00 PM Location: Town Office, 120 J St., Keysville, VA 23947

This hearing is to receive public comments on the adoption of the proposed Town of Keysville and Charlotte County Designated Growth Area (DGA) prepared by the Virginia Department of Transportation Planning Section.
The purpose of this hearing is to solicit input and receive comments specifically related to:
Trash, clutter, and cutting of grass and weeds
Requiring removal and repair of buildings and other structures
All hearings are OPEN TO THE PUBLIC.
You may present your views at the hearing or provide comments in writing.
Mailed to PO Box 42, Keysville, VA 23947
Please identify the subject and the commenter's name and address.
